description: This file implements dynamic partition pruning optimization in Apache Spark SQL, including logic for identifying filterable table scans, inserting pruning predicates, estimating benefits, and transforming logical plans to optimize query execution.

classes.name: PartitionPruning
classes.description: Object implementing dynamic partition pruning rules for logical plan optimization in Spark SQL.

methods.name: getFilterableTableScan
methods.description: Finds a table scan in the logical plan that can be filtered based on a given expression.

methods.name: insertPredicate
methods.description: Inserts a dynamic partition pruning predicate into the logical plan.

methods.name: pruningHasBenefit
methods.description: Estimates whether partition pruning provides a benefit based on size and statistics.

methods.name: calculatePlanOverhead
methods.description: Calculates heuristic overhead of a logical plan, excluding in-memory relations.

methods.name: hasSelectivePredicate
methods.description: Checks if a logical plan contains a likely selective filter predicate.

methods.name: hasPartitionPruningFilter
methods.description: Checks if a plan is suitable for partition pruning based on streaming and filtering criteria.

methods.name: prune
methods.description: Transforms a logical plan to add dynamic partition pruning where applicable.
